_comment: One golden case per generator was the original spec (plan.md §8), which needs a human to review actual output prose quality per generator -- that judgment isn't something to fabricate (see this issue's own reasoning). This is a starting set: real structural invariants (does a real claim survive re-verification, are banned generic-critique phrases actually absent), checked against the fixture's own already-curated papers, not invented text. Extend with more generators/cases as they get a real human content review, per evals/run.ts's header comment.
